summary.intent: Improve Cohezion's ability to model agents as Exotic Vacuum Objects (EVOs) by capturing agentic journeys through the Quadrature Nexus and FLUME VAE into SurrealDB, analyzing them via Ouroboros and Mycelium, and feeding synthesized patterns back to improve the system — then scale the autoresearch loop to run overnight and fix all remaining test failures.
summary.outcome: Built and ran a full autoresearch loop (E1-E76) accumulating 29,000+ experiment runs and 225,000+ SurrealDB journey_point records; fixed ~100 pre-existing test failures across FLUME, compound, cache, inference, integrations, universe, and patterns modules; created 10+ new compound analytics modules (session_metrics_aggregator, experiment_analytics, experiment_scheduler, health_monitor, compound_engine, loop_visualizer, etc.); raised the test suite from ~6,797 to 7,000+ collected tests.

repo: The Entire.io checkpoint daemon periodically commits working-tree changes to an orphan branch and resets the working tree — use `git checkout HEAD -- <file>` to restore files after unexpected reverts.

autoresearch.jsonl is a runtime log that should never be tracked by git (LFS pointer/content mismatch blocks pre-commit stash/restore); fix with `git rm --cached autoresearch.jsonl` + .gitignore entry.
The pre-commit hook has a Kaggle-branch guard that blocks commits touching competition files on main — use `KAGGLE_GUARD_DISABLE=1 git commit` for legitimate production fixes to those files.
SurrealDB SCHEMAFULL tables reject arbitrary metadata subfields — must serialize EVO biographies to the `result` field (option<string>) as JSON, not the `metadata` object.
conftest.py globally mocks `sentence_transformers.SentenceTransformer` with `MagicMock` to prevent AMD hardware BLAS segfaults — tests expecting real ST must add `@pytest.mark.skipif` guards.

The `_mycelium_calibration` dict is the persistent cross-cycle store; `_score_adjustments` is overwritten every `run_llm_deliberation` call — Mycelium feedback must target `_mycelium_calibration` to survive deliberation cycles.

autoresearch.jsonl stores experiment labels at `r['asi']['experiment']`, status at `r['status']` ('keep'/'discard'), and primary metric at `r['metric']` — NOT at top-level `experiment`, `verdict`, or `delta` keys.
The KAGGLE_GUARD_DISABLE env var disables the branch guard for competition files — documented in `.pre-commit-config.yaml` but not obvious from error messages.
Lemonade local inference (port 13307) enters a silent failure state where all evaluation prompts return empty strings — probe with `2+2=` arithmetic (not `/models` endpoint) to detect this.
FlumeVAE.forward() was changed to return 4 values (recon, mu, log_var, z) — callers that unpack 3 values silently fail at runtime rather than raising at import time.

code.finding: apply_mycelium_feedback() had SET semantics (`_score_adjustments[vt] = adjustment`) causing cycle 2 to decay below cycle 1 delta. Fixed to additive: `_mycelium_calibration[vt] += adjustment; _score_adjustments[vt] = _mycelium_calibration[vt]`. Convergence formula: consensus_n = 0.85 - 0.125 * (1 - lr/2)^n, validated to max_error=0.00025.

run_llm_deliberation() unconditionally SETs _score_adjustments[vt] = (llm_score - base) + mycelium_calib on every call, overwriting Mycelium adjustments. E47/profile experiments must modify _mycelium_calibration instead.

The original SurrealDBClient.connect() was entirely simulated. Real SurrealDB probe requires `RETURN true;` (not `SELECT 1;`). Datetime fields need `time::now()` not string literals. SCHEMAFULL blocks arbitrary metadata subfields — use the `result` (option<string>) field for JSON payloads.

TelemetryBus and JourneyWorker.start() were never called, so events queued silently and were lost on process exit. The overnight loop also manually pulled events from the bus queue, competing with the worker.

vault_write, vault_find_relevant_context, and other async methods were called synchronously in multiple callers, generating RuntimeWarning (unawaited coroutine). Added sync wrappers: vault_write_sync, vault_read_sync, vault_delete_sync using loop detection pattern.
Called vault_find_relevant_context() (async) without await in synchronous select_skills() method. Fixed by routing through vault_search() sync wrapper.
UCB1 sort for exploration filled the beam with untested transforms (UCB1=inf for trials=0), excluding perfect-score candidates. Fix: track best by actual score BEFORE UCB1 narrows the beam.

FlumeVAE.forward() was changed to return 3 values but callers expected 4. Added z back: returns (recon, mu, log_var, z). Added legacy MLP mode via FlumeVAE(input_dim=768, latent_dim=256) constructor. reparameterize() returns mu deterministically in eval mode. Added standalone flume_vae_loss() function.

encode() had a silent sentinel-return when 'input_ids' not in tokenizer output (returning torch.zeros). This violated CLAUDE.md anti-sentinel-value rule. Fixed to raise ValueError. Root cause: conftest.py mocks transformers but exposes PreTrainedTokenizer as MagicMock — fixed by adding it to the real-class allowlist.

conftest.py mocks transformers module but only exposes PretrainedConfig and PreTrainedModel as real classes, leaving PreTrainedTokenizer as MagicMock. FlumeTokenizer.__call__() returns MagicMock() yielding no items, causing 'input_ids not in inputs'. Fixed by adding PreTrainedTokenizer to the real-class allowlist.

Compound executor tests fail on high-CPU/memory machines because ResourceGuard reads real hardware stats. autouse fixture must mock BOTH psutil.virtual_memory AND psutil.cpu_percent (not just memory) — CPU at 99.4% on a busy machine triggers the 80% threshold.
check_precipitation() returns np.bool_ (from numpy comparison) — isinstance(np.True_, bool) returns False. All boolean returns from numpy comparisons must be wrapped with explicit bool() cast.
download_dataset_path() calls blocking kagglehub.competition_download() synchronously inside async def. Fixed to use asyncio.to_thread() so the event loop is not blocked.

log_result() signature is: (run: int, metric: float, metrics: dict, status: str, description: str, experiment: str, **extra). The E71-E76 experiments called it with 4 positional args in wrong order, missing run (first) and status (fourth).

workflow: Pre-commit hooks run ruff-format automatically and modify files in place, requiring re-staging after hook execution — cannot commit in a single pass when hooks change file content.
Surgical git add of specific files (not `git add -A`) prevents accidentally staging competition files or LFS data files that trigger branch guards.
The `stash push --keep-index` pattern conflicts with LFS pointer files — better to `git rm --cached` the runtime log file and add to .gitignore than fight the stash every commit.

TDD ordering matters for compound engineering: write tests that describe the desired behavior first (RED), then implement to make them pass (GREEN) — avoids implementing features that cannot be verified.
Adversarial review agents should run in parallel: scientific rigor reviewer + edge-case hunter + V-model compliance reviewer, each writing findings independently.
Retirement criterion for autoresearch experiments: CV(last-10-keeps) < 0.05 AND n_keeps >= 20 → self-prune. This prevents infinite accumulation of converged experiments.

The HIHO balance (0.5 threshold) should be applied to experiment scheduling: exploit (parameter sweep) when coherence >= 0.5, explore (new hypothesis) when below. AutoresearchEngine.generate_next_experiments() implements this.
timeit.default_timer() (alias for time.perf_counter) is the correct choice for experiment wall-clock timing — unaffected by NTP corrections unlike time.time().

When async methods have synchronous callers, the sync wrapper pattern must: (1) try asyncio.run(), (2) on RuntimeError close the coroutine to prevent 'coroutine never awaited' warnings, (3) create a new event loop as fallback.

friction: The Entire.io checkpoint daemon repeatedly reverted working-tree changes to orphan branches, requiring `git checkout HEAD -- <file>` restoration after every context compaction.
autoresearch.jsonl LFS pointer/content mismatch blocked all pre-commit stash/restore operations — required `git rm --cached` to untrack.
Pre-commit hooks modified staged files (ruff format), requiring re-staging in a loop that sometimes failed silently.
Kaggle branch guard blocked legitimate production fixes to competition-adjacent files on main — KAGGLE_GUARD_DISABLE=1 workaround undocumented.
Lemonade iGPU ROCm stack entered a silent failure state mid-session (all evaluation prompts returned empty strings) requiring fallback to heuristic mode.
The Gemini worktree (containing E55-E62 experiments and key production fixes) was cleaned up mid-session, losing ~3500 lines of work that had to be reconstructed.
SurrealDB timestamp format required `time::now()` not string literals — multiple iterations of debugging before root cause found.
The SurrealDB SCHEMAFULL constraint on metadata fields was invisible until runtime — only discoverable by actually attempting inserts.
psutil resource guardrail blocking tests on high-load machines was not obvious — conftest.py memory mock was insufficient; CPU mock also required.
Multiple async/sync boundary issues across vault.py, skill_selector.py, and cache_warmer.py required systematic discovery and fixing.
